title: Cache Key
statement: Implement `solve(kind, pure)`. `kind` is `int`, `str`, or `list`. `pure` is 1 when the function has no side effects. Return `cache` only when pure is 1 and kind is `int` or `str`. Return `skip` for lists, for impure functions, and for any other kind.
constraints: Impure functions must not be cached
hints: kind must be int or str.
editorial: lru_cache keys arguments by hash. A list is unhashable. A function that writes a counter or reads the clock is impure, so a cached return value is a stale lie. Both gates have to pass.
